decisions.reason: The source adds currency disclosure and selection UI rules but does not change the established USDC wallet mint execution flow.
The ETH-versus-USDC wallet-payment decision does not alter the deferred Transak card on-ramp or its fiat-to-USDC behavior.
Currency disclosure and selection do not change the mint price or revenue-allocation rules.
The source changes payment-method presentation, not the identity of the asset delivered by a successful mint.
The optional tipping behavior remains valid regardless of how the customer selects or is informed of the mint payment currency.
The source requires customer-facing currency disclosure or selection but does not specifically require an FAQ content change.
Payment-currency selection does not change the rule that the dashboard must show only successfully minted NFTs owned by the wallet.
The payment-method presentation decision has no effect on prize eligibility, weighting, or Chainlink VRF selection.
The source concerns primary-mint payment currency presentation and does not alter secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
Selecting or disclosing the payment currency does not change reward routing for mints with no valid referral code.
The source does not change confirmation-email contents, certificate behavior, or ebook access.
Payment-currency disclosure and selection do not alter the mint number's role or locations as the permanent referral code.
